name: Cambridge / Milton
description: A commuter Cambridge–Milton route designed around Milton GO train connections.

timeline.event: Ontario announced twelve weekday trips: four morning trips toward Milton and eight afternoon/evening returns.
The table lists Ainslie and Cambridge Centre terminals, the Hespeler corridor, Regional Road 25 / Highway 401 and Milton GO.

sources.title: Ontario adding twelve weekday GO bus trips between Cambridge and Milton, 29 April 2016
